# usage audience

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usageAudience`](gmeow-usageAudience.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usageAudience>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

The audience or scope in which the appellation is used — an [`Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md), a [`Group`](../classes/gmeow-Group.md)/Family, or a locale community. Range is [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md) to admit all of them. Non-functional. ('Aunt Genny' is used toward the family; 欧德理 toward a Sinophone audience.)
